Name: Loose Audio Files
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod allows you to create content packs with wav files that override the game's sound effects.


[size=5][b]Content Pack Creation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install this mod.
[*]Install the Example Content Pack mod from the optional files.
[*]Edit the [b]manifest.json[/b] in the content pack to your name, description, etc. Leave stuff you don't understand alone. Or just leave it alone, this step is optional.
[*]Edit the [b]wavebank.json[/b] file in the content pack, adding entries for each sound effect you want to replace (see below).
[*]Place a .wav file in the content pack's [b]assets[/b] folder corresponding to the value you put for each wav file in [b]wavebank.json[/b].
[/list]

[size=5][b]Wave Bank Format[/b][/size]

The format for [b]wavebank.json[/b] is:


[code]{
  "wavebank":{
"<SoundEffectName1>":
[
  "<WAVFileName1a>",
﻿   "<WAVFileName1b>",
],
"<SoundEffectName2>":
[
  "<WAVFileName2>"
],
etc.
  }
}
[/code]

[b]SoundEffectNameX [/b]must match an actual in-game sound effect. I've included a list from SDV 1.2 I found somewhere in [b]wavebankFULL.json[/b]. That file has codes that correspond to the in-game WaveBank sounds, which you can unpack with [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/782/?]unxwb[/url]﻿ if you want to modify them directly.

To find the name of a specific sound effect, you can turn on VerboseLog in the config.json file and watch what the SMAPI log tells you when a sound is played.

[b]WAVFileNameX [/b]can be whatever you want, just make sure you have a wav file with that name in the content pack [b]assets[/b] folder. Multiple wav files for each effect means the mod will choose one at random each time the effect is played.

You can also optionally just create a [b]wavebank.json[/b] file in the main mod and put your wav files in its [b]assets[/b] folder.


[size=5][b]Notes
[/b][/size][list]
[*][b]Do not [/b]use this mod as a music replacement. Bad things will happen. Same goes for anything ambient, or that involves gradual pitch changes like that fishing sound.
[*][b]wav [/b]files must be compatible with XNA specifications:
 "﻿The formats supported are: 8-bit unsigned PCM16-bit signed PCM24-bit signed PCM32-bit IEEE float PCMMS-ADPCM 4-bit compressedIMA/ADPCM (IMA4) 4-bit compressed" ﻿¯\_(ツ)_/¯ [*]Pitch and volume may not work 100%, though they seem to work generally, even with the flute block. If there's any 3D spatial audio in SDV, find a ten foot pole.
[/list]
Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url], uses Harmony.

Source code is available at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods/]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods/[/url].
